<thought>Based on the exact mass (179.0946 Da) the molecular formula is C10H13NO2. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon (~166 ppm), six aromatic carbons (~129–132 ppm), a methoxy carbon (~52 ppm), and two aliphatic carbons (~44 and ~39 ppm). This pattern fits a phenyl‑substituted α‑amino acid methyl ester where the nitrogen is methylated: methyl N‑methyl phenylglycinate. The corresponding SMILES is “COC(=O)C(NC)c1ccccc1”.> 
<final_answer>COC(=O)C(NC)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
